//reportUnsupportedDunderAll: The cross-context boundary shims (app/application/ports.py and the package __init__ files under app/contexts) publish a computed `__all__ = list(_MAPPING)` so the lazy re-export list has one source of truth. Pyright cannot statically verify a computed __all__, so it warns on those files; the pattern is deliberate — it is what keeps sibling contexts from importing each other eagerly — not a defect to code around.
